entries.name: Piercing Hiss
entries.rationale: A named important interrupt from Primal Serpents in the opening section.

entries.name: Toxic Atrophy
entries.rationale: The Writhing Coil casts this three times in succession; plan a kick rotation rather than relying on one player.

entries.name: Mass Envenom
entries.rationale: Stop Ula'tek's Chosen from applying the group poison; missed casts create additional dispel pressure.

entries.name: Paralyzing Shots
entries.rationale: Remove the Magic control effect applied by Twinfang Harrowers.

entries.name: Regurgitate
entries.rationale: Dodge Rav'i's cone first; cleanse the Disease only when a player is hit.

entries.name: Envenom
entries.rationale: Cleanse the Poison left by High Evolutionists or Ula'tek's Chosen, especially after a missed Mass Envenom stop.

entries.name: Ravenous Claws (enrage aura)
entries.rationale: Remove the Ravenous Descendant's Enrage or use a short stun and kite window to reset its dangerous attack-speed pressure.

provenance.description: Interrupt, dispel, purge, and recovery priorities were independently summarized from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 dungeon overview.
Spell IDs, NPC contexts, and low-level response flags are linked to the generated Midnight Season 2 ability index.
